definitions.explanation: The act of drinking a beverage quickly, whether in a competitive context, out of hurry, or as a social activity. Can refer to both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早飲|はやの}み⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{早飲|はやの}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Drinking too fast isn't good for your body, so be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早飲|はやの}み⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I don't have time in the morning, so I quickly drink my coffee and head out.

notes:
Composed of {早|はや} (fast, quick) and ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (drinking), the noun form of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink). Part of the productive {早|はや}+verb stem pattern: ⟦{早食|はやぐ}い→早食い：08481_hayagui⟧ (eating fast), ⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧ (getting up early), ⟦{早歩|はやある}き→早歩き：25674_hayaaruki⟧ (walking fast), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早飲|はやの}み⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: speed-drinking contest
- {早飲|はやの}み⟦{早食|はやぐ}い→早食い：08481_hayagui⟧: eating and drinking fast
- {早飲|はやの}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drink quickly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一気飲|いっきの}み→一気飲み：16505_ikkinomi⟧: chugging all at once — drinking an entire drink in one go, often used in party contexts
- ⟦{早食|はやぐ}い→早食い：08481_hayagui⟧: fast eating — the eating counterpart; also considered unhealthy
- ⟦{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す→飲み干す：21473_nomihosu⟧: to drink up — to drain a glass completely
